latest.name: Tripo AI (Tripo Studio)
latest.developer: VAST (Tripo AI); service operator/legal entity and Google Play app publisher: Holymolly Limited
latest.category: Cartoon, animation, avatar and character creation AI
latest.short_verdict: A distinct 3D character and asset creator: text or images become textured 3D meshes, with optional rigging and animation. The free plan includes 200 monthly credits (vendor estimate: about 13 base models), but free models are public/non-commercial and exports are capped at 15 per month (H2.5 only).
latest.what_it_does: Tripo Studio turns text prompts, single images or multi-view references into 3D models. It also offers AI texturing, segmentation, retopology, automatic character rigging and animation, with exports and integrations for 3D tools and game engines. Its core output is an editable 3D asset/mesh, not simply a cartoon video.
latest.why_try_it: Useful for prototyping stylized characters, creatures, props and game/animation assets without starting from scratch in Blender or learning full manual modeling. The free credits let a beginner test the generation and editing pipeline; the public/non-commercial license and export caps make the free tier for evaluation and personal experimentation, not commercial production.
latest.free_tier: Free Studio plan: 200 credits per month; Tripo estimates about 13 base models. The October 2026 pricing documentation lists standard HD model generation at 15 credits, rigging at 20, animation at 20, Smart UV at 20 and segmentation at 30; texturing varies by tier. The ≈13-model estimate is for base generation, not a complete textured/rigged character. Free includes one concurrent task, 15 exports per month (H2.5 only), 10 model-storage slots, 1-day edit history, 3 free retries, two Smart Mesh P2.0 trials and two Smart UV trials; integrated image generation has no free quota. The official pricing documentation says no credit card is required. Monthly credits reset each billing cycle.
latest.limits: The current pricing page labels Free models public and non-commercial; the October 2026 pricing/credits document says free outputs require attribution and IP belongs to Tripo. Exports are limited to 15 and H2.5 only; storage and edit history are limited. Only one task can run at a time. The pricing page and product documentation use different labels for free queue priority, so the exact priority is not asserted here. Texturing and post-processing consume additional credits, so a complete character can use substantially more than the 15-credit base generation. Smart Mesh P2.0 and Smart UV are limited trials; integrated image generation has no free quota.
latest.signup_pakistan: No Pakistan-specific prohibition was found in the public Terms (last updated 2025-07-11). The Terms say Tripo can be accessed from countries around the world but do not guarantee every service is available in every location. The official Free plan says no credit card is required. Pakistan-based signup and Pakistan Google Play availability were not independently tested. Paid payment methods are listed as major cards, PayPal and Alipay, with availability varying by region; acceptance of Pakistan-issued cards or PayPal in Pakistan is unverified.
latest.quality_evidence: Vendor claim: Tripo's homepage states 20M+ creators and 200M 3D models generated; these figures are not independently audited. Google Play listing: 500K+ downloads, 4.3 stars and about 17K reviews, updated 2026-11-06. Independent evidence: The AI Future rated it 4.0/5 in a research-based review dated 2026-11-02, but the outlet did not conduct its own hands-on test. A DEV Community reviewer (2026-10-07) tested a new free account and reported a reference-faithful model, while finding the raw mesh heavy and requiring retopology before game use. No standardized head-to-head benchmark was located. Play Store feedback is mixed and anecdotal, including reports of face-likeness and texture inconsistencies.
latest.android_status: Verified active Google Play listing: “Tripo - AI 3D Model Generator.” Google Play identifies Holymolly Limited as the publisher. The listing showed 500K+ downloads, a 4.3-star rating and approximately 17K reviews; it was updated 2026-11-06. The app supports photo/text-to-3D, restyling, preset motions and GLB/FBX export. Pakistan-specific Play Store availability was not independently verified.
